ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'other similar torments' refer to in Surah Sad?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the comprehensive nature of divine retribution, where the 'forms' (ashkal) of punishment mirror the specific sins of the disbelievers, reflecting the principle of *Jaza' bi-l-Qadr* (retribution according to measure). The phrase 'azwajun' (pairs or kinds) underscores the variety and intensity of the torment, serving as a warning that no aspect of their disbelief will go unaddressed in the Hereafter.
